mapper.insert: insert into prompt_template ( scope, template_code, template_name, version_no, state, content, variable_spec_json, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{scope}, #{templateCode}, #{templateName}, #{versionNo}, #{state}, #{content}, #{variableSpecJson}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: update prompt_template set template_name = #{templateName}, content = #{content}, variable_spec_json = #{variableSpecJson}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id} and state = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: select id, scope, template_code, template_name, version_no, state, content, variable_spec_json, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at from prompt_template where id = #{id} and ( scope = 'GLOBAL' ) limit 1
select count(1) from prompt_template where 1 = 1 and template_code = #{templateCode}
mapper.update: update prompt_template set state = 'PUBLISHED', version_no = version_no + 1, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and state = 'DRAFT'
update prompt_template set state = 'ARCHIVED', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and state in ('DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED')
